completion_promises.criterion_text: CorrelationIDMiddleware generates UUID4 for each request
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented in src/core/middleware.py CorrelationIDMiddleware.dispatch() method using uuid.uuid4() when X-Correlation-ID header is absent. Test test_generates_uuid4_when_no_header validates UUID4 format.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Incoming X-Correlation-ID header is respected if present
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented in src/core/middleware.py CorrelationIDMiddleware.dispatch() method which checks request.headers.get("X-Correlation-ID") first. Test test_respects_incoming_correlation_id_header validates this behavior.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Correlation ID stored in ContextVar and accessible throughout request lifecycle
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented using contextvars.ContextVar _correlation_id_var with get_correlation_id(), set_correlation_id(), and clear_correlation_id() helper functions. Test test_correlation_id_accessible_via_get_correlation_id validates the pattern.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Correlation ID bound to structlog context (appears in all log entries for that request)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented in src/core/middleware.py CorrelationIDMiddleware.dispatch() using structlog.contextvars.bind_contextvars(correlation_id=correlation_id) and unbind_contextvars("correlation_id") for cleanup.

completion_promises.criterion_text: X-Correlation-ID header added to all responses
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented in src/core/middleware.py CorrelationIDMiddleware.dispatch() which sets response.headers["X-Correlation-ID"] = correlation_id. Test test_correlation_id_passed_through_response validates this.

completion_promises.criterion_text: RequestLoggingMiddleware logs request start and completion
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented in src/core/middleware.py RequestLoggingMiddleware.dispatch() which logs request_started with method, path, client_ip at start and request_completed with method, path, status_code, duration_ms at completion.
Implemented using time.perf_counter() to measure duration in RequestLoggingMiddleware.dispatch(). Duration is calculated as (end_time - start_time) * 1000 for milliseconds.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Both middleware registered in correct order in main.py
completion_promises.evidence: Verified in src/main.py where app.add_middleware(CorrelationIDMiddleware) is called before app.add_middleware(RequestLoggingMiddleware), ensuring proper wrapping order.

Implemented in src/core/middleware.py RequestLoggingMiddleware with skip_health_logging parameter (default True). When enabled, logs are skipped for paths starting with /health. Test test_health_endpoint_skipped_by_default validates this.
